body: Bought this specifically for the oversized cut and it delivers, drapes well without looking like I grabbed the wrong size by accident. Pale blue is soft and not chalky like some listings show. I sized down to S from my usual M since the whole point is the relaxed fit, and that worked out exactly as hoped.

Comfortable oxford weave, good weight for layering over a tee. Ordered my true size M and the sleeves run long even accounting for the oversized style, I end up rolling them most days. Otherwise a solid shirt for the price.

I know it's meant to be oversized but even sizing down to S from my usual M, it's swimming on me a bit more than I wanted. Fabric quality is genuinely nice, good oxford texture and the pale blue looks true to the photos. Might have needed XS instead, my mistake more than the shirt's.

We ended up ordering two, one in M for him and one in S for me since it's unisex sizing and honestly it looks great on both of us, just styled differently. His fits with that boxy relaxed shoulder look, mine is more like a shirt-jacket over leggings. Fabric held up fine through the first wash too, no shrinking that we noticed.

Fabric is a bit lighter weight than I expected from an oxford cloth shirt, still nice but not the stiff structured feel I'm used to. Collar in particular is softer and doesn't hold as crisp a point. Sizing is generous, went with XS for a fitted-oversized look and got exactly that.

This has been on repeat since it arrived, open over a plain tank with jeans or buttoned up for something more put together. Pale blue goes with almost everything in my closet already. Runs true to the oversized description in L, plenty of room through the body without looking like a tent.

wasnt expecting much honestly for the price but its held up great through like 6 washes now, no fading no shrink. i got size M and its nice and loose like the pics showed, not too much tho. wear it basically every week now over a hoodie when its cold out lol

The oversized body shape is fine but the sleeves are disproportionately long even for the style, past my wrists by a couple inches in size M which is my usual. Fabric is decent quality, oxford texture is there, but I keep having to push sleeves up which gets old fast. Might exchange for S to see if that helps.

Wears well for a casual office setting, pairs easily with chinos. Color is a touch more gray-blue in person than the bright pale blue shown online, still nice just slightly different. XL fits with room to spare, exactly as expected for the oversized cut.

Already had the white and the sage version, added pale blue to the rotation now. Consistent sizing across all three in S for the oversized fit I like, and the stitching on this batch actually looks a touch neater at the cuffs than my older two. If you liked their previous oxfords this one won't disappoint.

Unfortunately mine came with a faint yellowish mark near the chest pocket that didn't come out in the wash. Shirt itself would have been fine otherwise, nice drape and the pale blue color matched the site photos well. Contacted support for a replacement, waiting to hear back. Frustrating since I needed it for an event.
Very oversized, size down if unsure.

this shirt very nice for casual look, i buy size M and is oversize how i want, fabric feel little rough first day but after one wash become more soft. color pale blue same like picture on website, not different. sleeve maybe little long but i just fold up, no big problem for me. good value overall i think.

I've been hunting for an oversized oxford that doesn't feel like a boxy potato sack and this one nails it, the shoulder seams drop just enough to read as intentional rather than ill-fitting. Fabric has a nice subtle texture up close, breathable enough for warmer days when worn open. I went with XS since I wanted the fit closer to how it's styled on the model, and that sizing choice worked out well. Only tiny note is the buttons feel a bit lightweight, not flimsy exactly, just not as substantial as I'd expect at this price. Would still buy again in another color.
